provenance.adaptation: one 600s native-frequency snapshot with separate GET/read and PUT/write channels; no Zipf or replicated keys
provenance.file_size_rule: one file per source key; ceil(max(io_offset+io_size)/2MiB)*2MiB
provenance.histogram_adaptation: exact operation-specific aggregation of source-key aligned transfer histograms into each bin; rendered percentages rounded to integers
provenance.operation_mapping: GET becomes read; PUT becomes write; retain op_count multiplicity
provenance.timeline: temporal order and original offsets are not replayed; random aligned reads and writes on synthetic content
provenance.transfer_alignment: cover each source I/O byte range with 4KiB-aligned span

static_native.coverage: configured request frequency approximation; not measured file/object heat
static_native.membership: source_key_indices maps Vdbench file index to Region7 profile key index
static_native.scope: one physical file per actual trace key; uniform selection inside each frequency bin and operation channel
